title: Hia5 Footprinting of lig50knuc and lig50
body:
### 1. FIBER-Seq for lig50k

*Per tube of lig50knuc* [4 reactions]
| Reagent | Stock | Volume |
|---|---|---:|
| Nucleosome solution | 14 ng/µL; approximately 200 mM salt | **12.000 µL** |
|Hia5 buffer + spermidine | 99 µL base buffer + 1 µL 100× spermidine | **5.000 µL** |
| Tris-HCl, pH 8 | **100 mM working stock** | **3.258 µL** |
| EDTA, pH 8 | **10 mM working stock** | **2.505 µL** |
| EGTA, pH 8 | **10 mM working stock** | **1.253 µL** |
| Spermidine | **100× stock** | **0.250 µL** |
| SAM | **32 mM** | **0.750 µL** |
| Hia5 | Your enzyme stock | **1.000 µL** |
| Nuclease-free water | — | **3.984 µL** |
| **Total** | | **30.000 µL** |

*Per tube of lig50k* [5 reactions]
| Reagent | Volume |
|---|---:|
| DNA, no salt | **2.00 µL** |
| SAM, **32 mM** | **0.50 µL** |
| Hia5 | **1.00 µL** |
| New Hia5 buffer | **16.50 µL** |
| **Total** | **20.00 µL** |

Incubate at 25 C, 1 hour.

### 1. Clean Up of Samples

| Starting footprinting reaction | Add **10% SDS** | Add **Proteinase K, 20 mg/mL** | Final volume | Final SDS | Final Proteinase K |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **20 µL** | **2.3 µL** | **0.6 µL** | 22.9 µL | 1.00% | 0.52 mg/mL |
| **30 µL** | **3.4 µL** | **0.9 µL** | 34.3 µL | 0.99% | 0.52 mg/mL |

Incubate at RT, 30 mins. Make up volume after combinining all tubes to 150 uL per sample type.
